answers.core: I do not believe this is possible in an asset library, but I would be happy to be corrected. As I said before, I believe the precedent is already there in the dropdown.
answers.workaround: I would use it frequently, but I'm not sure if other people have the same issue. I tried to figure out how to do it using a custom Import script but it seems quite tricky to move a resource that's already been added to a scene.
